name: 役割とメンバーの権限管理パネル
prompt:
Recreate the full Japanese conversation-permissions panel shown in the native preview, preserving its exact 390x670 white layout, wording, hierarchy, colors, control sizes, section spacing and row geometry. This is a faithful component reconstruction, not a redesign. Use the Japanese native preview as the authority for every existing panel element.

The source crop also contains an actual blue “Edit” hyperlink at the top right. Preserve that linked action as the localized label 「編集」, positioned at the top right beside the centered title 「会話の権限」. Render only this hyperlink in blue, matching the source accent (approximately #5865F2). This is required even though the current native preview omits the link. Do not turn any other control label blue.

Recreate the native panel: centered title 「会話の権限」; two-segment selector 「基本表示」「詳細表示」 with 「詳細表示」 selected in forest green; muted notice 「この権限は分類「交流の会話」と同期していません。」; pale-mint sync action with down chevron and forest-green 「今すぐ同期」; heading 「新しい権限」 and two plain white action rows 「役割を追加」「メンバーを追加」 with right-side green glyphs; heading 「役割」 with 「全員」 row and gray chevron; heading 「メンバー」 with mint 「山」 avatar, bold 「山田 はるか」, muted 「やまだ・はるか」 and gray chevron. Keep all non-link labels in their native dark, green or gray colors.

The original source crop provides the blue Edit hyperlink and meaning only; do not copy its English labels, photographic avatar, back arrow, gray background or card styling where they conflict with the native Japanese preview. Keep the screen clean and compact with no extra content, rows, shadows or screen chrome.
reviewNotes: a001: source Edit hyperlink preserved as blue 「編集」; panel content has progressive 10-20px downward drift and avatar is too large/left.
